source.candidateCommitPolicy: Current PAW source checkpoint integrating the Lab, Files, embedded App and README work with Session and Room conversation controls, selective text attachments and unified schedule management. Existing Runtime and store owners retain execution authority. Private development records and experiments remain outside the commit; local installation and foreground acceptance are recorded separately. This checkpoint also includes Earth Agent GIS and cloud/local workflows plus Knowledge and Lab recall diagnostics and search recovery; it does not declare installed foreground or binary-release acceptance.

dispositions.delete_old_implementation: Remove the relocated path once its consumer updates are verified.

brand_stellar.description: User-selected branding and bounded stellar visual behavior.

composition_refactor.description: Typed application dependencies and construction using existing Runtime and store owners.

lab_backend.description: Agent Lab package, resource resolution and service consumers.

lab_tools.description: Operator scripts that import Lab owners or record current source paths.

local_docs.description: Stop tracking local development records and their dedicated checks; preserve local files.

owner_boundaries.description: Product extension host assembly and module dependency checks.

pi_runtime_refactor.description: Single Host executor, explicit transport, history and UI projection boundaries; preserve Pi lifecycle and stored data.

portable_agent_ui.description: Shared Agent controls and their standalone bundle entry.

product_integration.description: Integrate current product source and public contribution guidance.

public_showcase.description: Public synthetic-data screenshots and usage documentation.

react_os_docs.description: Current React OS naming, architecture and development entrypoints.

refactor_docs_examples.description: Public owner navigation and an offline Lab adapter using the existing extension contract.

refactor_integration.description: Current imports, packaging inputs, Runtime source fingerprints and supported Python installation floor.

refactor_verification.description: Regression and architecture checks for the Runtime and application dependency refactoring.

references_history.description: Lossless reference archives, attribution and dated acceptance records.

room_frontend.description: Room partner windows, readable replies, sidebars and responsive layout.

room_service_refactor.description: Explicit Room work, dispatch, cancellation and approval dependencies with stable stores and events.

trace_optimization.description: Trace diagnosis and bounded optimization source, contracts and executable regressions.

verification.description: Regression checks for the included product changes.

voice_desktop.description: App naming and desktop voice integration.

offline_installer.description: Unsigned offline macOS installer using existing product lifecycle owners.

session_full_access.description: Full Access permission selection, automatic execution and focused regressions.

conversation_controls.description: Explicit collaboration layout, persistent background resource observers, opt-in memory, Session resource controls, and actionable model account recovery.

agent_capsule.description: Unified Agent Capsule app entry, global screen capture and same-Session recovery.

memory_lifecycle.description: Canonical Memory import/export, ingress privacy, daily reports and owner-scoped resumable refresh.

browser_recovery.description: Preserve Browser load errors, terminal receipts and same-tab recovery.

lab_frontend.description: Lab workflow presentation backed by project and experiment receipts.

scheduled_tasks.description: Unified schedule management for Agent, Eval and Memory using their existing schedulers.

earth_research.description: Google Earth Agent extension App, Pi execution package, examples and tests.

knowledge_runtime.description: Knowledge parsing, local MinerU runtime configuration and ingestion regressions.
